---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What's the problem you're trying to solve, or the gap you've hit? Skip the "as a user, I want" framing — just describe the situation.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. Be concrete if you can; rough is fine if you can't.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about and why this one is better (or why you're stuck).

## Scope

- [ ] Flutter client
- [ ] Cloud Functions
- [ ] Firestore rules / data model
- [ ] Verkada integration
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other:

## Additional context

Mockups, links to similar features in other tools, or anything else that helps.
